tiers.name: L0 — Casual / Single-File Edit
tiers.recommendation: Use Cloud Agent directly; invoke VieForge when handling >=1 noisy CI log or >=5 batch items.

tiers.name: L1 — Solo Indie / Vibe Coder
tiers.segment: Individual developers, freelancers, daily CI/test triage (5–50 items)
tiers.recommendation: Enable `vieforge setup` + `--mock-llm` or Ollama `qwen2.5:7b` for CI logs & small batch loops.

tiers.name: L2 — Power Dev / AI Content Studio
tiers.segment: Multi-project workstations, AI media/doc pipelines, 8–24GB VRAM (51–500 items)

tiers.name: L3 — Team / Agency / Enterprise Pipeline
tiers.segment: High-volume batching, multi-repo CI triage, Docker workers (500+ items)
tiers.recommendation: Deploy non-root Docker worker (`compose.yml`) + `core/policy_guard.py` + OTel `gen_ai.*` traces.
